developer_reply:
We're sorry to hear that you find the app too simplistic. The premise of the app is indeed simple. Every day, you simply mark your goals with a yes, no or skip and in return the app compiles and presents this data back to you.
If you are missing some functions in the app or have any ideas, please contact us at https://wayoflifeapp.com
